drills.name: Anti-Air After Corner Throw
drills.description: Opponent knocked down in the corner, 3 reversal options: cr.LP, vertical jump, or forward jump. Throw the cr.LP option, anti-air the jumps.
drills.source: Jason's practice routine (Anki deck + SF6 training-drill video guide)

0.note: cr.LP reversal -- dummy stays grounded, throw them

drills.name: CH vs Delayed Throw Tech
drills.description: Block After First Hit. Wake-up options are a 4-frame-delayed throw or nothing. Counter-hit into a combo when your delayed normal beats the throw's startup; tick-throw off a micro-walk when it doesn't.
drills.source: Jason's practice routine (Anki deck + SF6 training-drill video guide)

0.note: delayed throw (4f) -- beat the throw startup with a delayed normal for counter-hit, confirm combo

1.note: dummy does nothing -- your delayed normal gets blocked, react with a micro-walk into throw

drills.name: Knockdown Perfect Parry Practice
drills.description: A single meaty crouching medium punch on knockdown wakeup. Perfect Parry window is 2 frames (SuperCombo wiki, Street Fighter 6/Defense), then side-switch for the best punish.
drills.source: Jason's practice routine (Anki deck + SF6 training-drill video guide)

0.note: meaty crouching medium punch on knockdown wakeup -- perfect parry window is 2 frames (SuperCombo wiki, Street Fighter 6/Defense), then side-switch for max punish

drills.name: cr.MK Drive Rush Hit-Confirms
drills.description: Dummy walks at varied distances, sometimes into low guard. Hit-confirm cr.MK into a Drive Rush cancel combo on hit, or a jab frame-trap on block.
drills.source: Jason's practice routine (Anki deck + SF6 training-drill video guide)

1.note: variable walk distance into low guard

2.note: variable walk distance into low guard (second variant)

drills.name: Fuzzy Light Jab
drills.description: 3 slots off a jump-in plus-on-block normal: block the immediate jab, counter-hit the delayed heavy, or just block. One slightly-delayed 4-frame jab covers all three.
drills.source: Jason's practice routine (Anki deck + SF6 training-drill video guide)

0.note: jump, plus-on-block normal, 4f jab -- block the jab

1.note: jump, plus-on-block normal, heavy attack -- counter-hit the heavy

2.note: jump, plus-on-block normal, block -- just block

drills.name: Perfect Parry vs Drive Rush Overheads
drills.description: vs Juri, mid-screen. 3 Drive Rush overhead variants; react to the overhead animation with a deliberately late-timed parry to guarantee Perfect Parry, then punish.
drills.source: Jason's practice routine (Anki deck + SF6 training-drill video guide)

0.note: neutral jump, drive rush, standing medium punch

1.note: neutral jump, drive rush, crouching medium punch

2.note: neutral jump, forward medium kick -- time the parry slightly late to guarantee Perfect Parry, then punish

drills.name: Reacting to Jump/DI/Dash Jab
drills.description: vs an opponent abbreviated "DJ" in the source (inferred as Dee Jay, not independently confirmed). Anti-air the jump, Drive Impact the DI, stuff the dash-in jab with two lights into a special.
drills.source: Jason's practice routine (Anki deck + SF6 training-drill video guide)

0.note: neutral jump into any forward jump attack

1.note: neutral jump into Drive Impact -- react with your own DI

2.note: neutral jump into dash light punch -- stop with two lights into a special

drills.name: MP or MK>DR OS on Hit/Whiff into AA
drills.description: Poke with an option-select input. Combo on hit, anti-air if it whiffs and the dummy jumps, block if it whiffs and the dummy does nothing. Depends on both your poke's own outcome and which slot fires.
drills.source: Jason's practice routine (Anki deck + SF6 training-drill video guide)

0.note: neutral jump into any forward jump attack -- your poke+OS should hit, confirm combo

1.note: neutral jump into forward dash -- your poke whiffs, dummy jumps in, react with anti-air

2.note: neutral jump into block -- your poke whiffs, dummy does nothing, just block

drills.name: Reacting to Neutral DR/Jump
drills.description: Block, anti-air, or stuff a Drive Rush with a reactive poke, depending on which of 3 randomized options the dummy plays from a neutral walk-up.
drills.source: Jason's practice routine (Anki deck + SF6 training-drill video guide)

0.note: walk forward/backward into block -- do nothing

1.note: walk forward/backward into forward jumping attack

2.note: walk forward/backward into drive rush attack -- stuff with your best poke on reaction

drills.name: 6HK > 236HP > HP > 22HP (Corner Wall-Bounce Juggle)
drills.description: No reaction needed -- landing the combo IS the success condition. In the corner, cancel 6HK into 236HP for the wall bounce, link HP off the bounce (the hard part), then cancel into 22HP.

combo_route.note: 6HK cancels into 236HP -- causes the wall bounce
the hard part -- a true link off the wall bounce, not a cancel; this is where the juggle actually starts
